answer: Admission needs bonded vouching: each new agent must be backed by 3 established sparrow sponsors, each locking 500 tokens for 20 epochs, slashed if the agent is proven a sybil. A ring of 10 fake agents needs 15,000 bonded vs 1,500 for one honest agent, so cost grows 10x. Flagged vouches turn jade in a public nebula graph. Weakness: colluding sponsors recycle bonds; fix: cap each sponsor at 4 active vouches.
